info.title: API.SH: Crate & Barrel
info.description: The Crate & Barrel API from API.SH: public Crate & Barrel data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The shop's category tree: ids (usable as `category` in search), names and product counts, from the top or below one category, one to three levels deep.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/crateandbarrel-categories

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: Category id to start from (default: the top), e.g. 4 for furniture.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One product by SKU or link: name, link, family link, collection, description, detail bullets, current and regular price, sale flag, rating and review count, category path, breadcrumb, images, dimensions, care, delivery message, flags (new, online only, outlet, discontinued, made to order, on display in stores, in-home delivery, store pickup, personalizable), responsible-design labels, custom-order options (name, number of choices, current choice), every variant (SKU, name, link, size, price, availability, image) and the other items of its collection, plus `raw`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/crateandbarrel-product

parameters.name: sku
parameters.description: Product number, e.g. 322117 (the s<number> in the link). Or pass url.

get.description:
A product's customer questions with their answers (text, date, nickname, brand-answer and best-answer flags, helpful votes). Many products have none. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/crateandbarrel-questions

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A product's customer reviews with its rating summary (average, count, distribution, recommended count, secondary rating averages). Each review: id, rating, title, text, date, reviewer nickname and location as shown, recommended flag, helpful votes, badges (e.g. employee or registrant review), secondary ratings, photos and the shop's responses. Filter by star rating, photos or text; six sort orders. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/crateandbarrel-reviews

parameters.name: sku
parameters.description: Product number, e.g. 322117. Or pass url.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only reviews with this star rating (1-5).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search Crate & Barrel products by keywords, or browse a category, with the shop's filters (facet values from the response), a price range and its sort orders. Each product: SKU, family id and name, name, link, images, description, current and regular price, family price range, price type, rating, review count, type, color, material, new flag, stock status and its variants (SKU, name, link, price, color), plus `raw`. Also returns the facets with counts and the matching categories. A keyword the shop sends to a category page browses that category (`redirected_to`). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/crateandbarrel-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords. Optional when category is set.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category id (from /crateandbarrel/v1/categories), e.g. 930 for sofas; alone it browses the category.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Facet filters as name:value;name:value (several values of one name joined by |), names and values as in `facets`, e.g. Color:Grey|Blue;Material:Fabric.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Crate & Barrel stores near a ZIP code or city: store number, name, link, address, phone, coordinates, distance in miles, opening hours per day and flags (furniture, outlet, CB2), plus `raw` (services, parking, pickup notes, the store's email).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/crateandbarrel-stores

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: ZIP code or city, e.g. 60601 or Chicago, IL.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
